General-purpose AI models whose primary inputs and outputs are digital content, including
text, image, audio, video, and code. The label General AI is used in this report as shorthand
for this general-purpose model domain, not as a claim about artificial general intelligence.

Systems that use tools, pursue goals over multiple steps, make delegated decisions, maintain
state, or coordinate with other agents.

Embodied or cyber-physical systems, including robots and autonomous vehicles, that perceive
and act in the physical world.
